impact: Pandas default type inference casts nullable integer to float64, converting ID 1187 into 1187.0
recommendation: Cast explicitly to string with regex strip (.replace(\.0$, )) or use nullable Int64 before joining.

impact: 16 matches in matches.csv have 0 records in ball_by_ball.csv due to rain abandonments without a ball bowled.
recommendation: Do not use simple inner joins without handling abandoned matches; inner joins drop these 16 matches silently.

impact: 3 matches (36210, 41503, 48513) have no playing eleven squad records because games were abandoned prior to toss.
recommendation: Use left join from matches.csv to playing_eleven.csv with null awareness.

impact: 2 UAE players (Basil Hameed: 39444, Syed Haider: 36153) participated in 3 matches but were missing from playing_eleven team sheet.
recommendation: Player master registry should use competition_team_player_mapping.csv which contains 100% of all players.

impact: 3 competitions (3405, 3473, 2940) in competitions.csv have zero scheduled/recorded matches in matches.csv.
recommendation: Filter competitions based on inner join with matches.csv when generating active competition tables.

impact: Revised overs and targets are null for 97% of matches (populated only for DLS rain-affected matches).
recommendation: Fallback to standard 120 legal balls and (Innings 1 score + 1) when DLS revised values are null.

impact: Captaincy IDs are null in ~5% of matches (unrecorded captaincy in certain bilateral series).
recommendation: Cross-reference is_captain flag from playing_eleven.csv to backfill missing captain records.

impact: Bowl speed is recorded as 0 in 97.7% of deliveries due to speed gun telemetry absence.
recommendation: Do not use bowl_speed as an essential feature for bowler pace classification; use pace_or_spin instead.

impact: Contains 2 non-IPL and non-T20I emerging regional cups (30 matches, 6,985 deliveries).
recommendation: Explicitly filter scope to IPL and T20I matches only before calculating official player pressure rankings.
